risks.title: Geopolitical Volatility and International Operations
risks.summary_en: HAL's operations in more than 70 countries are exposed to political instability, wars, terrorism, sanctions, and trade restrictions. While geographic diversification reduces risks, a major disruption could significantly affect results.
risks.score_rationale_en: Risk positioned at the beginning of section (Item 1, Business Environment), strong language ('adversely affected', 'war', 'armed conflict', 'sanctions'), stable trend but heightened geopolitical context, geopolitical category carries heavy weight for the global energy sector.

risks.title: Raw Materials Dependency and Supply Chain
risks.summary_en: HAL depends on critical raw materials (sand, chemicals, metals, electronic components) whose availability may be constrained by market conditions. The company manages this risk through its supply relationships and purchasing power.
risks.score_rationale_en: Risk in central section (Raw materials), moderate language ('constraints', 'can trigger'), stable trend but acknowledges current vulnerabilities, industrial category relevant for energy services.

risks.title: Competitive Intensity and Pricing Pressure
risks.summary_en: HAL operates in highly competitive markets with many substantial competitors. Competitive factors include price, service quality, HSE standards, and talent retention, creating constant pressure on margins.
risks.score_rationale_en: Risk in Markets and competition section (Item 1), direct language ('highly competitive markets', 'many substantial competitors'), stable trend, competition category carries heavy weight for energy services.

risks.title: Currency Fluctuations and Foreign Exchange Risks
risks.summary_en: With 61% of revenue outside the United States, HAL is exposed to currency fluctuations, exchange restrictions, and highly inflationary currencies. This exposure affects consolidated results and cash flow.
risks.score_rationale_en: Risk mentioned in Business Environment section, moderate language ('foreign currency exchange rates', 'highly inflationary currencies'), stable trend but relevant for operations in 70 countries, macro category carries heavy weight.

risks.title: Dependency on Global Talent Retention
risks.summary_en: With 46,000 employees across 146 nationalities, talent retention is critical. HAL recorded 9% voluntary turnover in 2025. Loss of key personnel could affect the ability to innovate and serve customers.
risks.score_rationale_en: Risk in Workforce section (Item 1), explicit language ('Our workforce is our top asset', 'attract and retain talent'), stable trend but acknowledges critical challenge, key person category carries heavy weight for labor-intensive services.

risks.title: Decline in Fossil Energy Demand
risks.summary_en: The global energy transition toward renewable energy threatens long-term demand for traditional oil and gas services. HAL is investing in low-carbon energy but remains dependent on the fossil sector.
risks.score_rationale_en: Implicit risk in context (energy transition mentioned in highlights), indirect but strategic language ('sustainable energy future', 'low carbon energy business'), new/increasing trend, existential macro category for the oil sector.

risks.title: Partial Divestiture of Chemical Business
risks.summary_en: HAL has decided to sell a portion of its chemical business (Multi-Chem), with closing expected in the first half of 2026. This divestiture could affect operational synergies and segment revenues.
risks.score_rationale_en: Risk in Completion and Production section (Item 1), neutral language ('strategic decision to market for sale'), new trend (announced for H1 2026), capital category with moderate weight.
